subject.title: fix(heartbeat): skip heartbeat when session idle too long, back off after consecutive idle skips

question: Should OpenClaw accept a hardcoded seven-day scheduled-heartbeat idle safety floor while the configurable activity-timeout tracker remains open?
rationale: The source bug and scoped repair are clear, but the fixed default changes upgraded heartbeat behavior and overlaps the open public idle-timeout product decision.

options.title: Accept Scoped Safety Floor
options.body: After the backoff mismatch is corrected, merge the scheduled-only idle gate as an immediate spend guard for stale sessions.

options.title: Wait For Configurable Policy
options.body: Keep this PR blocked and solve idle behavior through the existing configurable activity-timeout tracker with schema, docs, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Require Opt-In Only
options.body: Ask for an explicit setting or operator-facing warning instead of changing default scheduled heartbeat behavior for existing users.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Safety Floor
recommendation.body: After the backoff mismatch is corrected, merge the scheduled-only idle gate as an immediate spend guard for stale sessions.
